question: Do frozen zero-shot Qwen planner views (Q1..Q3) improve retrieval of complete gold evidence over the original question alone (Q0), with everything else fixed?

benchmark.name: KC-COL-IR-v0.1
benchmark.gate: tools/independent_ir_v2.py preflight(): cuda_ready=true, baseline_gate.unlocked=true, >=10 ACCEPTED_RETRIEVAL_GOLD; otherwise the experiment does not run
benchmark.validation_and_holdout: not used by this experiment; no tuning on validation

arms.P1_PLAN: Q0 + frozen planner views Q1..Q3 replayed from reports/query_plans/<experiment_id>/ via the existing plan-mode implementation

held_constant: same question ids and exact question text (sha256 checked against A's question_text_sha256)
same frozen corpus (hashes from A's handoff manifest)
same retrieval backend/component and config file as A's frozen baseline (recorded by sha256)
same candidate depth (candidate_k) and output k
same exact-locator setting; locator resolves Q0 only in both arms
same gold (A's gold/dev.jsonl, read only after rankings are written)
same metric implementation: tools/independent_ir_v2.py score() (sha256 recorded at run time)
fusion_rule: P1 uses A's native retrieve(Q0, k, 'off', query_views=[Q1..Q3]) when the frozen backend exposes query_views; otherwise B's rrf_merge (constant 60) over per-view rankings of depth candidate_k, truncated to k. The rule is fixed by the backend recorded at freeze time, not chosen after results.

planner.input: public question text only (no options, passages, labels, gold ids)
planner.malformed_output: fallback to Q0 only, counted in diagnostics
planner.generated_references: untrusted retrieval text; never receive exact-locator privileges
planner.plans_frozen_once: one freeze per question set; no re-planning after seeing DEV results

metric_population: questions with corpus_coverage == COMPLETE (A's metric_population); MISSING/PARTIAL/AMBIGUOUS reported separately, never counted as ranking failures

adopt_PLAN_if_all: 95% paired-bootstrap CI lower bound of delta Evidence Completeness@8 (P1 - P0) > 0
point estimate of delta Document Recall >= 0
selection_rule.otherwise: keep BASE (Q0 only) as the production retrieval mode
selection_rule.ties_or_insufficient_n: keep BASE; report as inconclusive (no claim)
selection_rule.no_post_hoc_changes: planner prompt, fusion rule, depth and k may not be changed after seeing DEV results; any change requires a new experiment id declared before running
